name: zepedrosilva
description: Claude Code plugins by José Silva.

plugins.name: brand-studio
plugins.description: Drafts a brand identity for your app as checked SVG, for developers without a design background: concept, mark, wordmark, palette, exports and a brand sheet. Also reviews existing SVG logos against numbered, sourced rules.

plugins.name: viz-advisor
plugins.description: Decides which visual to use in a presentation or an application before anyone draws it: a chart, a diagram, a table, a KPI tile or a plain sentence, with the reason, what to avoid and encoding hints. Also reviews visuals already chosen.

plugins.name: deckhand
plugins.description: Plans, builds and reviews Stream Deck plugins with the official Elgato SDK: what keys, dials, touch strips and the Neo infobar can and cannot do, tested TypeScript patterns, and a 50-rule review.
